# Azure Cosmos DB Assistant

Skills and agents that teach agents to work with Azure Cosmos DB Assistant. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [AzureCosmosDB/cosmosdb-claude-code-plugin](https://github.com/AzureCosmosDB/cosmosdb-claude-code-plugin), at commit `f1e0498`.

Best-practice rules and an expert agent for designing and tuning Azure Cosmos DB.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Azure Cosmos DB Assistant**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Azure Cosmos DB Assistant**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install azure-cosmos-db-assistant@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

1 skills: `cosmosdb-best-practices`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

The plugin has one agent, `cosmosdb-expert`, and one skill, `cosmosdb-best-practices`, with 73 best-practice rules.

It ships no scripts. The vendor's slash commands and example MCP configuration are not included.
